name: scrawl
description: Scrape pages to Markdown or JSON, map sites, crawl into versioned datasets, extract with a schema, ask cited questions and download files with Scrawl, over its MCP server or the scrawl CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Read the web through ApexAi's Scrawl service
interface.longDescription: Scrape a page to clean Markdown or schema-checked JSON, map a site, crawl into versioned datasets, query and diff them, ask cited questions and download a job's files. Connects to Scrawl's MCP endpoint with your API key, or drives the scrawl CLI.
